title: Dispatch by code area instead of by card: area leases, one PR per coupled set, follow-ups folded (pilot on domain:server after 18.4.0; maintainer launches)
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filing gate: ② a decision only the maintainer can make: it changes the dispatch protocol (`execution-duties.md` claim rules, `os-dev` one-card scope, lane files). The maintainer asked for it in the triage#1 session: 「换个角度说现在这样一张卡一张卡的认领是最佳的方案吗？」 · 「你先评估出试点方案，等版本发布完成之后我会启动这个试实验」 · 「但这是一个长期的规则，你不能只考虑队列中的这些卡。」 · 「第一张卡决策卡，具体写你的方案」. ⛔ Not a claim.

## 维护者速读

- **问题**:现在每张卡单独认领、单独派一个开发会话、单独契约复审、单独进合并队列。卡彼此独立时这样最好;但现在大量卡挤在同几个文件上,固定开销远大于实际改动,同一文件被不同会话轮流改,跟进卡还在自我繁殖(server 队列 127 张里 80 张是已落地 PR 的跟进或小问题)。
- **方案(推荐 A)**:改成**按代码区域认领**——席位认领一个区域一段时间,同一会话连续做区内的卡;改同一函数、修法互相影响的卡合成一个 PR;跟进项默认在原 PR 修,每个落地 PR 最多一张汇总收尾卡。先在 server 车道试 3 个工作日,指标达标再推广。
- **请回一个字母**:A(区域租约 + 试点)、B(只采纳两条低风险规则:跟进项不一项一卡、不该进队列的不进)、C(维持按卡认领)。

## 一句话问题

一张改十行的卡和一张改一千行的卡付出几乎一样的流程成本,同一个文件上的几张卡被几个会话轮流重读、串行等待、合并时互相覆盖;车队越清,队列越长。

## Evidence (2026-11-13)

- server lane: 147 open cards (127 queued). 80 of the 127 are follow-ups or nits of landed PRs; 108 were filed on 11-12 or 11-13. An independent analysis (fable tier, `origin/main` `64c426ab22`) groups them into 28 coupled sets plus singles: **127 dispatches → about 57**, with 10 cards prunable (each verified: already closed, duplicate, fixed by a merged PR, or a flake anchor).
- One defect, three sessions: "host unregister deletes environment rows" ran as #32986, #33003 and #33043, three cards and three sessions on the same `metadata-manager.ts`, serial, with a near-overwrite on merge (PR #33006 against PR #32999, flagged by review).
- Follow-up fan-out: PR #32987 spawned 5 follow-up cards; PR #32815 spawned 6.
- Queue cascade: PR #32932 ejected #32577 and #33024 behind it (#33037).
- Review rounds: PR #32973 (a text-only upgrade-guide correction) took 4 contract-review rounds.

## Options × real cost × workload

| | What | What the fleet and the maintainer feel | Workload |
|---|---|---|---|
| **A** | Area lease (rules R1–R8 below), piloted on `domain:server` for 3 working days after 18.4.0, then rolled out lane by lane if the metrics hold | Fewer dispatches (estimate −55% on server), no concurrent edits of one hot file, fewer queue cascades, fewer new cards per landed PR; PRs somewhat larger on coupled sets | `domain:skills`: 1 rule PR (`execution-duties.md`, `os-dev.md`, `lanes/server.md`, new `references/areas.md`) at contract tier; triage: one W0 tidy pass; no product code. Precedent: #32906 / #32997 (rule write-ups, one PR each) |
| **B** | Only R5 (follow-ups folded) and R7 (decision and flake cards kept out of the queue) | Follow-up growth slows; dispatch cost per card and hot-file collisions unchanged | `domain:skills`: 1 small rule PR |
| **C** | Keep per-card claiming | Backlog keeps regrowing at the current rate | 0 |

## 业务含义直译

A 等于从「每张工单派一个临时工,各自从头熟悉现场」改成「每个片区一个固定师傅,一个片区的活连着干,同一处管道的几个问题一次修好」。B 等于不换派工方式,只要求修完顺手把小毛病一起修掉、不再每个小毛病开一张新工单。C 等于维持现状。

## The long-term rules (A)

- **R1 Area table.** Each lane keeps an area table drawn from code structure (a package or file family), not from the cards of the day. Each area lists its path prefixes, its **hot files** (one session at a time), and a default seat. The table lives in managed references and changes with the code: the lane proposes, triage checks, the maintainer approves.
- **R2 Cards enter an area at first touch.** Triage adds `area:<x>` with the grade. When a new card names a function an open lead card already changes, with interacting fixes, it is folded into the lead (a checklist line on the lead, and the new card closed `completed` with a pointer) instead of queuing.
- **R3 Area lease replaces per-card claim.** A seat claims `Lease: area:<x> · <session> · until <condition>`. One holder per area at a time, and one dev session works the area's cards in priority order with warm context. A lease ends at its condition, at sign-off, or after 6 h with no output; the hand-over brief lists the in-flight card and the next one. p0 and release blockers bypass leases.
- **R4 One PR per coupled set only.** Cards that change one function with interacting fixes become one PR, with one contract review and one queue entry. Unrelated cards in the same area stay one small PR each, worked back to back by the same session. A review that yields more than 3 behaviour-changing follow-ups marks the PR as too big: the next step splits it or continues on the same card.
- **R5 Follow-ups fold back.** Non-blocking review or report items that are comment-only, text-only, a single pin, or ≤30 lines are fixed in the same PR with a delta review. Behaviour-changing follow-ups go into at most **one** loose-ends card per landed PR, as a checklist, graded by #32997 (default p3).
- **R6 Landing re-checks named cards.** When a PR body names open cards, landing posts "re-measure or close" on each and takes it out of the dispatchable state until confirmed.
- **R7 Keep non-work out of the queue.** Cards that need a maintainer letter go to `needs-user-decision`, never `pm:queue`. A queue-flake anchor with 1 independent hit and a green queue for 24 h closes itself; one with a known root attaches to the root PR's card.
- **R8 Weekly rebalance.** Areas that sit idle merge; areas with a long queue split or gain a seat.

## The pilot (A)

- **Scope.** `domain:server` only, for D+1 to D+3 after the 18.4.0 cut. The other lanes stay per-card as the control group.
- **Initial areas** (calibrated on today's cards, adjustable):
  - Epic seats: E1 registry and hydration; E2 App pair and boot census; E3 `packages/metadata` storage plus security catalog; E4 runtime action routing and function holders.
  - General seats: G1 MCP plus analytics; G2 storage plus approvals; G3 auth/SSO plus messaging; G4 driver-sql plus automation plus CLI.
- **W0, on launch day, cards only, no dev dispatch.** Triage closes or folds the 10 verified prunes, folds the 28 coupled sets into their leads, regrades about 10 p2 pin/text/chore cards to p3 (#32997), and moves letter-needing cards to the decision box.
- **Waves.** W1 is p1 and data-correctness sets (about 10 units / 25 cards), W2 is the remaining p2 (about 33 units / 50 cards), and W3 is p3 batches (about 14 units / 36 cards). These counts are estimates, not measurements.
- **Metrics,** compared with the 3 days before and with the per-card lanes:
  1. Dispatches per card (target ≤ 0.5).
  2. Contract-review rounds per PR (target: no rise).
  3. Merge-queue failures and their cascades (target: down).
  4. New follow-up cards per landed PR (target ≤ 1).
  5. Daily net queue change (target: negative).
  6. Concurrent sessions on one hot file (target 0).
- **Exit (any one ends the pilot and restores per-card claiming):** review rounds up by more than 50%; queue cascades up; an area holder idle 6 h with a p1 waiting more than 4 h; or the maintainer stops it. If the pilot is stopped, R5 and R7 stay; they are low-risk.
- **Roll-out if the metrics hold:** `domain:skills` writes R1–R8 into the references, and lanes adopt it one by one (ui → spec → skills; cloud and HotCRM as one area per repo).

## Four facets

os-decision-facets
① 项目长远合理性: 派工单位与代码结构对齐(区域表随代码变),同一热文件单写者,跟进项回流原 PR——减少特例与重复读取;规则不依赖当期卡片。
② 实际业务拉动: 今天 server 队列 127 张、每天净增;一次缺陷拆三卡三会话、单 PR 生 5–6 张跟进卡、队列连带失败都已实测。
③ 防 AI 犯错: 同一会话连续持有一个区域,读过的代码与上一张卡的修法在上下文里,跨卡改同一函数时不再互相覆盖;热文件单写者让合并冲突变成「排队」而非「静默覆盖」。
④ 创业阶段不扩散: A 新增一张区域表与一个租约行,删掉的是每卡一次的派发与复核开销;B 是最小面;试点有明确退出条件。
Prior rulings read: 「需要我决裁的问题,立决策卡」; #32906/#32997 (grading); 11-12 09:41Z rule "simple review findings become their own cards, no extra PR round" (R5 revises it); `os-dev` one-card scope (R3/R4 revise it); thread: triage#1 session 2026-11-13.

## 推荐 + 置信缺口

**推荐 A。** 终态句:两年后车队像成熟工程团队一样按代码归属分工——每个区域有固定负责人、热文件单写、相关修改一次落地、评审意见在原 PR 里收口;参照 Google/Meta 的 OWNERS 与 code-area 值班、Linux 子系统维护者模型。
不取 B:只治跟进卡增长,不治同一文件多会话轮流读改的根因。不取 C:积压持续净增。
自检:只看①选 A;②③④ 是否翻转:否。
盲区,明说:
- 57 次派发、约 20 单元/天的吞吐是估算,没有实测;试点的意义就是测它。
- 合并后的 PR 会变大,复核轮数可能上升;退出条件盯住这一点。
- 区域边界初版由一次分析给出,头几天可能需要调整(R8)。
- 一个区域单写者会降低该区域的并行度;对同一热文件这是正确的,对互不相干的卡由「同会话连续做」弥补,但单会话吞吐上限未测。
- 契约复审在试点期间仍由分诊接(发版期例外的延续)还是回到车道自审,请一并定。

## 裁后执行

- **A**:18.4.0 发布后当天,分诊做 W0 整理并在本卡记录;server 车道席位按区域登记租约;3 个工作日后分诊在本卡贴指标对照与去留建议,交维护者定是否推广;推广则 `domain:skills` 一个 PR 写入 R1–R8 与 `references/areas.md`。
- **B**:`domain:skills` 一个 PR 写入 R5、R7,即日生效。
- **C**:关卡。

Working files (triage scratch, for reference): the full plan and the per-card server analysis (merge sets, serial chains, prune evidence) are summarised above; the merge-set list is reproduced on request.
